referenceSource.title: Steady-duty hydraulic work identity and explicit efficiency-stage accounting
referenceSource.version: EPANET2.2 getenergy reference context; independent Decimal SI identity v1
referenceSource.locator: getenergy: power proportional to flow*head*specific gravity divided by aggregate efficiency (US customary). Here explicit SI work=rho*g*V*H joules; joules/3600000=kWh. Declared pump/motor/drive stage efficiencies are test inputs, not source equipment data.

independentCalculation:
Independent 60-digit Decimal steady-duty SI energy accounting.
No production imports/execution/network. Direct Joule/day arithmetic and explicit
stage efficiency products; no equipment curve or field/annual applicability claim.
